meta.name: paid-channel-prioritizer
meta.description: For founders who don't know where to start with paid ads. Analyzes ICP, competitor ad presence, budget constraints, and product type to recommend which 1-2 paid channels to start with and provides a 90-day ramp plan. Prevents the common mistake of spreading a small budget across too many platforms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析付费渠道并制定90天投放计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚起步做付费广告，不确定选哪个渠道。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze paid channels and create a 90-day ad plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to paid advertising and unsure which channel to start with.

howto.what: 分析你的产品、目标客户、竞争对手和预算，推荐1-2个最适合的付费广告渠道，并给出90天分步启动计划。
howto.when: 当你询问“该在哪里投广告”、“哪个广告平台适合我”、“预算有限如何分配”等类似问题时触发。

say.text: 我每月有3000美元广告预算，该投哪个平台？
say.note: Claude会分析你的产品和客户后给出推荐。

say.text: 帮我选一个付费渠道，我的产品是SaaS，面向中小企业。
say.note: Claude会结合你的业务模型和预算给出建议。

howto.what_en: Analyzes your product, ICP, competitors, and budget to recommend 1-2 best paid ad channels and provides a 90-day ramp plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask where to run ads, which platform to use, or how to allocate a limited budget.

say_en.text: I have $3K/month for ads, where should I start?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze your product and audience.

say_en.text: Help me pick a paid channel for my SaaS targeting SMBs.
say_en.note: Claude will consider your business model and budget.
